[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: SKU packaging spec session — 3h with Nathan (printing company, Changsha, Hunan)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  Three hours of discussion with Nathan (WeChat +86 18926843778, WeChat ID ycy18926843778, region Changsha, Hunan, China) from the printing/packaging company, working through SKU packaging specifications.
  
  WHAT THE SESSION COVERED:
  1. SKU PACKAGING SPECIFICATION — worked through the printed packaging artwork for the SKU range, including the physical sample carrying a V2.1 version marking, an 'AG 119' code, a 'HOWTOUSE' (方法) instruction panel and 'MEMWOOD' branding. Reviewed the printed sample against intended product presentation ahead of a production order.
  
  2. MATERIAL, PRINT AND BINDING DETAILS — the discussion ranged over the physical construction of the packaging: material stock, printing, and binding/finishing options, which is where the bulk of the three hours sat. These are the decision points that determine per-unit cost and lead time at production volume.
  
  3. SUPPLIER RELATIONSHIP AND CHANNEL — Changsha, Hunan is a major printing and packaging manufacturing hub, and the supplier relationship was established and is conducted over WeChat, the standard channel for Chinese manufacturing suppliers. A direct factory relationship at this stage matters for SKU unit economics at scale.
  
  WHY THIS WAS WORTH THREE HOURS: SKU packaging specification is a hard-to-reverse decision — once artwork and construction are locked and a production run is placed, changes carry tooling cost and lead-time penalties. Getting material, print and binding settled in one sustained session with the factory, rather than over a slow back-and-forth, is what the time bought. It also establishes a direct factory relationship rather than going through an intermediary.
  
  TIME BASIS: 3 hours = 180 minutes, as directed by the governor. TDG derived by the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes / 60 * 100 = 180 / 60 * 100 = 300.00), not supplied by hand.
  
  ATTACHMENTS:
  - nathan_printing_sku_evidence_2026-11-18.pdf (attached to this submission) — 4 pages, one source image per page with an explanatory caption:
    p1 — WeChat contact profile for Nathan: +86 18926843778, WeChat ID ycy18926843778, region Changsha, Hunan
    p2 — WeChat conversation showing the initial contact exchange and accepted friend request
    p3 — Photograph of the SKU printed packaging sample (portrait), with legible fragments V2.1 / AG 119 / HOWTOUSE (方法) / MEMWOOD
    p4 — Second photograph of the same SKU packaging sample (landscape)
  - Mirror copy in the context repo: contributions/evidence/2026-11-18_nathan_printing_sku_evidence.pdf
  
  EVIDENCE LIMITATION (stated plainly): pages 3 and 4 are photographs of physical packaging, not documents. OCR recovers only fragmentary text (V2.1, AG 119, HOWTOUSE, MEMWOOD) because the sample is a printed product shot at an angle with Chinese-language print. They evidence that a physical sample was under discussion; they do not reconstruct the full artwork text. The specification detail above is the governor's stated account of the session, not machine-extracted from the images.
  
  NOTE ON PR FIELD: this is operational work (a supplier conversation), not code, so it has no PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited are from the same working thread, where the PDF generation SOP and its indexing were authored and merged; they are included only because the reporting tool requires at least one pull URL and refuses non-pull GitHub links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: nathan_printing_sku_evidence_2026-11-18.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/nathan_printing_sku_evidence_2026-11-18.pdf
